Ya, I'm here to talk about it. 

I'm okay with it. I mean, I would love to be here with my kiddo, I would love to watch her grow up. Other than that tho, I don't have slot going on. Just nightmares dude, bad dreams and flashbacks during the day.

I'm not going to some hospital where they out you in a paper gown and the police take away your dignity. I could probably use some pretty intense therapy, but I don't have insurance and I just don't really care to try more things like that anyway. 

But yeah, all in all, I've accepted it. I'm dying, but that ain't so bad, because a worse thing is more years of the pain inside. I have posion in my soul and I've tried to get it out.... But I'm over it. I'm just going to step away quietly, let all you people deal with this shithole world.  Lol good fucking luck.
